addOnRules.name: Daily Hot Buffet Dinner Catering (50 Pax - 7 Courses + Drink)
addOnRules.description: Fresh hot buffet dinner for 50 guests (Halal / Vegetarian / Non-Vegetarian options) complete with food warmers and bio-cutlery.

addOnRules.name: Consignment Beverage & Tidbit Starter Pack
addOnRules.description: Assorted canned drinks, Yeo's packets, bottled water, and tidbits. Only opened cartons billed at final settlement.

addOnRules.name: Multi-Camera High-Definition Private Livestreaming Service
addOnRules.description: Dedicated videographer broadcasting memorial and cortege service via password-protected HD link for overseas family.

addOnRules.name: AI Digital Tribute Montage & Interactive Guest QR Portal
addOnRules.description: Customized digital tribute page with QR code for guests to upload photos, audio messages, and memories streaming live on-site.

addOnRules.name: Straits Times / Lianhe Zaobao Print Obituary Placement Liaison
addOnRules.description: Drafting, sizing, proofing, and publication booking liaison with Singapore Press Holdings (SPH space charged at net cost).

casketUpgradePolicy.explanation: When upgrading from a package's default included casket to a higher tier model, the family is credited the full itemized retail value of the default casket against the upgrade selection.
casketUpgradePolicy.milestoneRule: Casket upgrades must be confirmed prior to final body placement and encoffinment. Once encoffinment is sealed, casket changes incur an additional S$300 sanitization and transfer surcharge.

durationExtensionPolicy.explanation: Extending a wake duration beyond the baseline package allowance (e.g. extending from 3 days to 5 days) is billed at S$350 per additional calendar day, covering extended canvas rental, additional coordinator shifts, daily restroom sanitization, and town council permit renewals.

downgradeRules.generalPolicy: Downgrading an active package to a lower tier or direct disposition is permissible only prior to physical tentage erection or embalming commencement.
downgradeRules.lockoutCondition: Once transport team is dispatched or void deck canvas is erected, full setup labor and logistics costs are non-refundable.

deposit.explanation: A mandatory booking deposit of 30% of the taxable quotation subtotal (including GST) is required to lock in the operational schedule, dispatch transport, and reserve mortuary facilities.

coolingOffPeriod.condition: Full refund of deposit granted if cancellation is requested within 24 hours of booking, provided no operational dispatch or embalming has commenced.

cancellationAndRefunds.description: Cancellation within cooling-off period before transport or embalming team is dispatched.
cancellationAndRefunds.netDeduction: Flat administrative fee of S$150.00 deducted to cover registry file opening and permit queuing.

cancellationAndRefunds.description: Cancellation after transport team has been dispatched and deceased removed from hospital or residence.
cancellationAndRefunds.netDeduction: S$350.00 dedicated removal transport fee deducted.

cancellationAndRefunds.description: Cancellation after professional arterial sanitization, embalming, dressing, and cosmetological styling have been completed.
cancellationAndRefunds.netDeduction: S$800.00 clinical labor and consumables fee deducted.

cancellationAndRefunds.description: Cancellation after HDB void deck canvas tentage or parlour has been fully erected and utility meters tapped.
cancellationAndRefunds.netDeduction: 50% of the total base package price is billed to cover third-party logistics, canvas labor, and municipal permit costs.

cancellationAndRefunds.description: Cancellation on the final day of the cortege procession to crematorium or cemetery.
cancellationAndRefunds.netDeduction: 100% non-refundable; full contracted quotation is billed.

paymentTerms.balanceSettlementMilestone: Final balance of 70% plus any signed daily interim variable consumption sheets is payable on the final cortege day prior to crematorium entry or within 7 calendar days of service completion.
paymentTerms.deferredPaymentConditions: Subject to verified Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) ComCare Funeral Assistance Scheme application reference or CPF Dependants' Protection Scheme (DPS) payout verification.

financialAssistanceSchemes.eligibility: Low-income Singaporean families with per capita household income below established ComCare thresholds. Solace Dignity Care provides direct filing assistance and deferred invoicing.
financialAssistanceSchemes.claimProcess: Family provides MSF case officer reference; invoice balance is frozen pending government disbursement.

financialAssistanceSchemes.schemeName: CPF Dependants' Protection Scheme (DPS) & Deceased Bank Account Settlement
financialAssistanceSchemes.eligibility: Insured CPF members under Great Eastern Life or Singapore Life.
financialAssistanceSchemes.claimProcess: Solace Dignity Care provides formal itemized tax invoices and certified death extracts for rapid claim filing.

financialAssistanceSchemes.schemeName: Solace Dignity Care Life Foundation Pro Bono Afterlife Support
financialAssistanceSchemes.eligibility: Elderly individuals with no next-of-kin, destitute cases, or families facing severe financial distress certified by medical social workers.
financialAssistanceSchemes.claimProcess: 100% pro bono Direct Cremation package coordinated with zero out-of-pocket costs.

gstAndPricingIntegrity.pricingTransparencyStandard: All commercial service items, package base rates, and optional upgrades are quoted net of GST. Singapore 9% GST is calculated transparently on the commercial subtotal. Third-party statutory government disbursements are passed through at net cost with 0% markup and zero GST addition.

NEA Choa Chu Kang Burial Plot Lease Fee (Christian/Chinese)
NEA Inland Ash Scattering Fee (Garden of Peace / Garden of Serenity)
Town Council Void Deck Space Permit & Metered Tap Deposit

gstAndPricingIntegrity.dailyInterimAuditProtocol: Variable consumption items (refreshment beverage cartons, extra food warmer portions, and physical floral stands) are audited and signed off by the next-of-kin and on-site Butler every 24 hours to prevent unexpected final billing surprises.
